info.name: ViQure API — full manual test pass
info.description: 73 backend endpoints + phase add-ons, in dependency order. Setup: (1) npm run seed  (2) npm run dev  (3) select the 'ViQure Local' environment  (4) run folder 02 to capture tokens. Folders 01–14 = current backend (after plan Phase 0 patches); folders 15–18 unlock as Phases 2/3/5/6 land. Companion docs: TESTING_RUNBOOK.md + MVP_EXECUTION_PLAN.md. Re-run 02 logins after any reseed or JWT_SECRET change.

item.name: 01 Health
item.description: Server up check. Run `npm run dev` first.

item.name: 02 Auth
item.description: Logins capture {{adminToken}}/{{customerToken}}/{{doctorToken}} — re-run this folder after every reseed or JWT_SECRET change. Fresh registrations use timestamped emails so the folder is repeatable.
